title: [review] tx_queue.py:373: TOCTOU between expire_sta
description: ensure_can_push() builds active_entries with a fresh clock() call, but push() then checks len(self._entries) which reflects the earlier expire_stale() call. If entries expire between calls, preemption logic may evict a non-expired entry when expired ones exist. Benign in practice due to microsecond timing window vs second-scale deadlines.
